topic: Facility data filtering and frequency logic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in facility data, specifically regarding traffic and unique user counts (uniques) between the platform and internal scripts. It was determined that filtering for `is_active` facilities resolved some inconsistencies.

A major issue identified was the frequency calculation logic: initially, the system mixed ML-API frequencies with outdated/default frequencies. The root cause was traced to missing frequency data for certain companies (e.g., company number 7955) in the ML-API setup.

It was established that for Japan, the platform and ML-API generally only use active facilities (`dashboard.excludeInactiveFacilities`). Furthermore, it was noted that setting frequency parameters at the parent level is preferred over individual child settings, as this ensures consistency across all associated companies.

The team confirmed a global fix for the complex frequency logic issue is in development.
decisions: Filtering facility data to include only active facilities resolved discrepancies in traffic and unique user counts.
Frequency parameters should be standardized at the parent company level for consistency across all Japanese entities.
action_items: Implement a global fix for the frequency calculation logic (in development).
Update facility data filtering to consistently use only active facilities.
